card.name: Error codes and error-related wording
card.fires_on: Partway through POSIX error code names like EACCES, EMFILE and ENFILE in man-page error lists. It also fires on small words just before an error or adverse-event term, such as 'An' before 'error occurred'.

modes.label: Error code names
modes.description: Inside or at the start of errno constants in a list of error codes.
modes.example: ERRORS EACC<<ES>> Search permission denied for directory in file's

modes.label: Words before error or adverse-event terms
modes.description: Small words or quote marks that lead into an error or a named adverse event such as depression.
modes.example: Adverse events coded as<< ">>depression" were reported at similar rates

card.writes: It promotes words like excess, unnecessary, incorrect and improper, and suppresses programming error and compile words.
card.plain: It fires on error code names and on little words that lead into something wrong or unwanted.
